{{Top|notoc=1}}
{{Citation}}
[[File:RaidingTheBunker-GAW.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Commandos storming a bunker]]
{{Quote|Sir. I have five special commando units awaiting your orders, sir.|[[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone trooper commander]] [[Ponds/Legends|Ponds]], to [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]]|<ref name="Episode 2">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
A '''commando''' (''plural '''commandos''''' or '''''commandoes''''') was generally a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] that was suited to environments and situations that most other units would not be able to handle, either due to training or equipment, making commandos similar to [[Special forces/Legends|Special Forces]].

{{Military-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Commando_Operations_LotDS_by_Ben_Zweifel_FFG.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Commandos opening fire in a swamp]]
In the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', the commando was one of the professions to survive the so-called "New Game Enhancements" of [[2005]] and be included as one of the nine iconic starter professions. In the game, they specialize in the use of heavy weaponry and other explosives.

The commando is an advanced class for the [[Republic trooper|trooper]] class in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' MMO video game.<ref name="Holonet-Trooper">{{Holonet|classes|trooper|Trooper}}</ref> This advanced class specializes in heavy [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] cannons and [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]]. The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] counterpart for this archetype is the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]].<ref>{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20100820-0|text=Fan Friday}}</ref>
